    69  /**
    70   * This class implements MLE TLV generation and parsing.
    71   *
    72   */
    73  OT_TOOL_PACKED_BEGIN
    74  class Tlv : public ot::Tlv
    75  {
    76  public:
    77      /**
    78       * MLE TLV Types.
    79       *
    80       */
    81      enum Type
    82      {
    83          kSourceAddress       = 0,  ///< Source Address TLV
    84          kMode                = 1,  ///< Mode TLV
    85          kTimeout             = 2,  ///< Timeout TLV
    86          kChallenge           = 3,  ///< Challenge TLV
    87          kResponse            = 4,  ///< Response TLV
    88          kLinkFrameCounter    = 5,  ///< Link-Layer Frame Counter TLV
    89          kLinkQuality         = 6,  ///< Link Quality TLV
    90          kNetworkParameter    = 7,  ///< Network Parameter TLV
    91          kMleFrameCounter     = 8,  ///< MLE Frame Counter TLV
    92          kRoute               = 9,  ///< Route64 TLV
    93          kAddress16           = 10, ///< Address16 TLV
    94          kLeaderData          = 11, ///< Leader Data TLV
    95          kNetworkData         = 12, ///< Network Data TLV
    96          kTlvRequest          = 13, ///< TLV Request TLV
    97          kScanMask            = 14, ///< Scan Mask TLV
    98          kConnectivity        = 15, ///< Connectivity TLV
    99          kLinkMargin          = 16, ///< Link Margin TLV
   100          kStatus              = 17, ///< Status TLV
   101          kVersion             = 18, ///< Version TLV
   102          kAddressRegistration = 19, ///< Address Registration TLV
   103          kChannel             = 20, ///< Channel TLV
   104          kPanId               = 21, ///< PAN ID TLV
   105          kActiveTimestamp     = 22, ///< Active Timestamp TLV
   106          kPendingTimestamp    = 23, ///< Pending Timestamp TLV
   107          kActiveDataset       = 24, ///< Active Operational Dataset TLV
   108          kPendingDataset      = 25, ///< Pending Operational Dataset TLV
   109          kDiscovery           = 26, ///< Thread Discovery TLV
   110
   111          /**
   112           * Applicable/Required only when time synchronization service
   113           * (`OPENTHREAD_CONFIG_ENABLE_TIME_SYNC`) is enabled.
   114           *
   115           */
   116          kTimeRequest   = 252, ///< Time Request TLV
   117          kTimeParameter = 253, ///< Time Parameter TLV
   118          kXtalAccuracy  = 254, ///< XTAL Accuracy TLV
   119
   120          kInvalid = 255,
   121      };
   122
   123      /**
   124       * This method returns the Type value.
   125       *
   126       * @returns The Type value.
   127       *
   128       */
   129      Type GetType(void) const { return static_cast<Type>(ot::Tlv::GetType()); }

   131      /**

   301      bool IsValid(void) const { return GetLength() >= sizeof(*this) - sizeof(Tlv); }

   303      /**

   307       *
   308       */

   310
   311      /**

   313       *
   314       * @param[in]  aTimeout  The Timeout value.
   315       *
   316       */
   317      void SetTimeout(uint32_t aTimeout) { mTimeout = HostSwap32(aTimeout); }
   318
   319  private:
   320      uint32_t mTimeout;
   321  } OT_TOOL_PACKED_END;

   323  /**
   324   * This class implements Source Address TLV generation and parsing.

   326   */
   327  OT_TOOL_PACKED_BEGIN
   328  class ChallengeTlv : public Tlv
   329  {
   330  public:
   331      enum
   332      {
   333          kMinSize = 4, ///< Minimum size in bytes (Thread Specification).
   334          kMaxSize = 8, ///< Maximum size in bytes (Thread Specification).
   335      };
   336
   337      /**
   338       * This method initializes the TLV.
   339       *
   340       */
   341      void Init(void)
   342      {
   343          SetType(kChallenge);
   344          SetLength(sizeof(*this) - sizeof(Tlv));
   345      }
   346
   347      /**
   348       * This method indicates whether or not the TLV appears to be well-formed.
   349       *
   350       * @retval TRUE   If the TLV appears to be well-formed.
   351       * @retval FALSE  If the TLV does not appear to be well-formed.
   352       *
   353       */
   354      bool IsValid(void) const { return GetLength() >= kMinSize; }
   355
   356      /**
   357       * This method returns the Challenge length.
   358       *
   359       * @returns The Challenge length.
   360       *
   361       */
   362      uint8_t GetChallengeLength(void) const
   363      {
   364          return GetLength() <= sizeof(mChallenge) ? GetLength() : sizeof(mChallenge);
   365      }
   366
   367      /**
   368       * This method returns a pointer to the Challenge value.
   369       *
   370       * @returns A pointer to the Challenge value.
   371       *
   372       */
   373      const uint8_t *GetChallenge(void) const { return mChallenge; }
   374
   375      /**
   376       * This method sets the Challenge value.
   377       *
   378       * @param[in]  aChallenge  A pointer to the Challenge value.
   379       *
   380       */
   381      void SetChallenge(const uint8_t *aChallenge) { memcpy(mChallenge, aChallenge, GetChallengeLength()); }
   382
   383  private:
   384      uint8_t mChallenge[kMaxSize];
   385  } OT_TOOL_PACKED_END;

   421      bool IsValid(void) const { return GetLength() >= sizeof(*this) - sizeof(Tlv); }

   425       *
